cards.specification: Reaggregate retained V20 candidate/native forecasts where locally available; add fresh supplied-law enumerations only under the new allocation. Grid: four evidence tiers × history 0/4/64 × native/changed execution. Compute exact conditional entropy, Bayes modal accuracy, Brier uncertainty and regret for each reader. Rival: the entire gap is unavoidable ambiguity. Continue to A02 where multiple incompatible targets remain; to B01 where substantial excess regret remains. Stop after every target has a valid error-budget row; do not train for this card. Output: information-versus-reader-failure table and cases usable by Sounding Line.

cards.title: — Separate uncertainty from decoding error

cards.specification: Partition trajectories by observed evidence and then by the seven-bit target, with exact transition identities where possible. Compare exact-history, partial-history and equivalence-class scoring; grid: artifact/context/sparse/complete, inspection hidden/observed. Rival: an apparently wrong exact answer still describes a supported member of the same equivalence class. Continue when a new observable separates classes; stop if the proposed cue leaves all class likelihoods identical. Export class mass and individual-member uncertainty, never relabel coarse accuracy as exact historical accuracy.

cards.title: — Equivalence-class histories

cards.specification: From unchanged joint forecasts, choose full process, partial field set or abstention at loss ratios 1/2/5/10 for false specificity. Match an abstaining direct rival. Score coverage, expected loss and number of alternatives retained. Rival: gains are simply fewer claims. Continue to fresh-law confirmation only if a policy improves loss at matched specificity or specificity at matched error. Stop when all apparent benefit is changing coverage. Product consumer: how to expose an honest historical tree without silently omitting plausible routes.

cards.title: — Coarse-to-fine answer policy

cards.specification: Add only the already separable observation switch, then vary missingness 0/0.25/0.5/0.75 and false-record rates 0/0.05/0.2. Include missing-at-random and inspection-dependent missingness. Compare models that recognize the observation process with a naive absent-means-no-inspection reader. Continue to D02 if selective logging matters. Stop the naive historical claim when absence has no identifying power. This tests a concrete analogue of Git history gaps, not whether version control records thought.

cards.title: — Witnessed inspection versus hidden inspection

cards.specification: Learn a finite maker-latent model from permitted training labels, then marginalize maker state across histories; compare V20 naive Bayes, direct MLP, direct frequency table and a grouped-history empirical rival. Grid: history 0/1/4/16/64, label budgets 512/2,048/8,192. Truth-maker identities may be used only in a separately labeled supervised diagnostic; the primary learner cannot receive them. Continue when shared-latent benefit survives label/support matching; to B02 if direct groups match; stop after one bounded fitting repair if collapsed states eliminate the intended manipulation. Consumer: whether a tiny personal predictor is an informative context producer.

cards.title: — Shared-maker conditional model

cards.specification: Replace independent feature multiplication with episode-group likelihoods; compare full Bayes, composite likelihood with fixed calibration-selected powers 0.25/0.5/1, and a learned pooled empirical model. Grid: independent histories versus repeated/partly copied episodes at 0/0.5/0.9 duplication. Rival: B01's gain came from suppressing overconfidence rather than learning a maker. Continue if grouping improves both calibration and proper loss under fresh duplication rates; stop a maker-mechanism interpretation if generic tempering matches it. Do not tune temperature on final worlds.
cards.status: initial native diagnostic verified with full replay; generic tempering wins here; candidate-cell/wide/shift/calibration-transfer scope and copied-cell superiority conditional
cards.title: — Grouped evidence and dependence tempering

cards.specification: Vary the probability an episode comes from the same maker at 1/0.9/0.5/0 while keeping context and episode count matched. Compare correctly informed mixture, inferred mixture and rigid same-maker model. Include shuffled-author histories. Continue if the inferred mixture detects contamination without discarding useful persistence. Stop personalization scale-up if unrelated histories help equally. This is a clean information ruler for author corpus contamination and ghostwriting in Sounding Line.
cards.status: original/wide supplied-law information ruler verified with full replay; inferred contamination protection fails; learned detection conditional
cards.title: — Persistence strength

cards.specification: Introduce one independently controlled change in preference, execution skill or context law; positions at 25%/50%/75% of a 32- or 96-episode stream. Compare static maker, all-fast updating, all-slow updating and a mixture over which role changed. Match direct chronological models. Continue to B05 when role-specific updating earns a held-out benefit; stop any attribution to stable values when the model cannot distinguish skill change. Use paired prefixes so horizon differences are not confounded with different streams, a known qualification in earlier Ghost work.
cards.status: initial binary-role supplied-law chronological ruler independently checked and admitted; full scientific replay pending; learned direct models and original-world extension conditional
cards.title: — Stable preference versus changing skill

cards.specification: Compare raw history, sufficient maker posterior, a small predictive head, source-linked episode ledger and predictor-plus-ledger at matched byte ceilings 256/1,024/4,096/16,384. Evaluate future endpoint prediction separately from past-order and inspection recovery. Rival: compression merely throws away historical information not needed for prediction. Continue if a hybrid offers a useful cost/quality frontier; stop calling predictive compression historical memory when it fails the order witness. No per-person LLM adapter is necessary in Ghost; Sounding Line tests that implementation.
cards.status: conditional implementation; not a runnable job
cards.title: — Compress a personal predictor without losing episodes

cards.specification: Extend a tiny exact world with separate knowledge-of-option, execution skill and permitted-action variables, each binary initially; keep goals constant in counterfactual twins. Compare a goal-only model, skill-only model, joint model and matched direct reader. Reveal one factor at a time. Continue when the new factor explains a specific error and improves held-out predictions; stop expansion after exact aliasing shows no available cue separates the accounts. Source inspiration: robust IRL's subjective dynamics model, not a claim that the toy variables measure human traits.
cards.status: conditional implementation; not a runnable job
cards.title: — Knowledge, ability and external constraints

cards.specification:
The theory's transfer claim needs adaptation data: add a sparse-mechanism-shift card

**Finding.**
- **V20's shift test gives structure no way to help.**
  - Readers get zero shifted labels.
  - The structured reader has no separate execution factor.
  - The measured "transfer" is an artifact (GS-1).
- **The theory's claim is modular.** If the maker model is separate from the execution law, a change in execution should require re-learning only the execution factor.
- **Causal machine learning states the testable version.** The correct factorization adapts faster to a modified distribution when the change is concentrated in one or a few mechanisms ([Bengio et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.10912)).

**Change.** Add card **G21-B07, adaptation under a sparse execution change.**
- *Readers:*
  - a modular reader, with a maker/policy factor learned natively and an execution factor re-estimated from shifted episodes;
  - the converged direct reader, fine-tuned on the same shifted episodes;
  - the fresh-law rival, fine-tuned the same way.
- *Adaptation data:* k ∈ {0, 16, 64, 256} labeled changed-execution episodes, drawn from shifted training lineages.
- *Score:* adaptation curves against the shift-aware law-marginal.
- *Promising* if the modular reader reaches a fixed loss with a quarter or fewer of the shifted labels the direct reader needs.
- *Stop* the transfer claim if direct fine-tuning matches it at every k.

---
cards.status: implemented; sparse-current-shift headroom gate required
cards.title: Adaptation under a sparse execution change

cards.specification: Start from one fixed joint predictor q; derive its exact marginals and form their product without retraining. Compare the unmasked joint and product, both after a common support projection, and a support-only template. A mask can reintroduce dependencies, so separate learned dependence from constraint enforcement. Grid: four evidence tiers and weak/strong planted target dependence. Rival: V20's separately trained factorized model failed from optimization rather than lost dependence. Continue to C02 if a dependence loss remains; stop a causal jointness claim based solely on separately trained heads.
cards.status: implemented opening consumer; individual blocks require admission
cards.title: — Same-reader factorization ablation

cards.specification: Compare direct 128-way head, autoregressive seven-bit head, pairwise factor graph and low-rank joint tensor with matched evidence, label counts and either matched parameter or matched CPU frontiers. Use 2/3 registered widths, chosen on engineering worlds; report fit cost rather than claiming perfect capacity matching. Test two variable orders. Continue only if joint-loss benefit is robust to ordering and compute. Stop architecture searches at the finite registered settings; an optimizer failure earns one repair, not unlimited tuning.
cards.status: initial finite original-law native/changed parameter frontier verified with full replay; dependence-specific superiority not established against direct marginal-product control; wider scope conditional
cards.title: — Matched learned joint architectures

cards.specification: Compare no support, broad physically legal support, learned support and supplied exact support. Freeze the training source of every support rule. Grid: native and shifted laws; true support omitted at 0/0.01/0.05/0.2. All V20 rivals already shared exact support; its presence alone cannot explain their relative difference. Test the method-by-support interaction and whether any gain survives removing deployment-unavailable knowledge. Continue when coverage and gain survive without oracle support. Stop deployment promotion when gain disappears or incorrect pruning creates unrecoverable errors. Consumer: hard constraints versus tentative hypotheses.
cards.status: implemented opening consumer; individual blocks require admission
cards.title: — Oracle support privilege ladder

cards.specification: Supply evidence reliability 1/0.95/0.8/0.5 and compare hard masks with soft likelihood factors, with matched source truth. Include a false but apparently authoritative record. Score true-history exclusion, confident errors and proper loss. Continue if the soft model protects against incorrect exclusion while using reliable records effectively. Stop hard constraints for fields whose source model admits noise. A real commit log can be truthful about edits while its inferred semantic label is wrong; keep those levels distinct.
cards.status: initial finite diagnostic verified with full scientific replay; supplied reliability and support limitations retained
cards.title: — Soft inconsistency versus hard rejection

cards.specification: Omit 0/10/25/50% of true candidate types using train-frozen mechanism-based omission, not test-label-informed ranking. Compare forced choice, an explicit finite-unknown bucket, uniform expansion, evidence-ranked expansion and oracle supplied truth. Budgets 8/16/32/64. Continue where coverage and full-universe loss both improve; stop an apparent gain confined to candidate-event scoring. Preserve that this is finite-universe omitted mass, not open-world concept invention.
cards.status: conditional implementation; not a runnable job
cards.title: — Candidate omission and calibrated unknown mass

cards.specification: Start with a model missing a belief, constraint or operation-order variable; offer a finite registered successor library. Compare confidence-triggered expansion, posterior predictive surprise, expected gain per cost and fixed expansion. Grid: omission present/absent × weak/strong cues × search budgets 1/2/4. Rival: a wrong model can be confidently wrong. Continue if held-out predictive checks find omitted mechanisms without chronic unnecessary expansion. Stop expanding when no successor changes likelihood distinctions. This provides a known-answer stress test for AutoToM-style variable adjustment.
cards.status: conditional implementation; not a runnable job
cards.title: — Evidence-driven model expansion

cards.specification: Offer three record classes: operation event, contrasting-context episode and noisy maker cue. Compare expected information gain about historical target, action entropy, fixed cheapest, random and no acquisition at fees 0/0.01/0.05/0.2. Include a deliberately irreducibly random distractor. Score actual target-loss reduction per total acquisition plus decoder cost. Continue if selection beats the strongest cheap policy; stop if reduced entropy fails to improve the target or merely buys more records. Research anchor: active IRL's random-action trap.
cards.status: initial four-condition supplied-law ruler verified with full replay; fee-adjusted gain holds, entropy distractor trap inactive; learned acquisition and real CPU pricing conditional
cards.title: — Information gain versus prediction entropy

cards.specification: Generate true event streams, then observed records under independent thinning, squashed commits, delayed batching and event-dependent deletion. Hold final artifact fixed in matched twins. Compare endpoint-only, observed-record reader, observation-process-aware reader and full-record oracle. Rates 0/0.25/0.5/0.75; squash windows 1/2/4. Continue on a named missingness mechanism if modeling it improves held-out historical coverage. Stop treating record completeness as known when metadata cannot identify it. Consumer: Git history offers useful targets but not complete mental-process ground truth.

cards.title: — Incomplete version history

cards.specification: Vary 1/2/4/8 reports from 1/2/4 independent roots; hide or corrupt source IDs in 0/10/30% of cases. Compare supplied provenance, inferred dependence, naive multiplication and a conservative correlation bound. Continue if inferred dependence gains survive source-ID permutation and new copying graphs; stop if advantage requires perfectly supplied root identities. V20 already tested known copying; this branch addresses the useful remaining uncertainty instead of repeating it.
cards.status: initial native original-law grid and full replay verified; robust uncertain-provenance gain not established; learned models and wider laws conditional
cards.title: — Copied evidence with unknown source groups

cards.specification: Permit up to 1/2/4/8 purchases. Compare one-step greedy information, a two-step lookahead, fixed-budget acquisition and uncertainty-threshold stopping. Include evidence complementarities: neither record alone resolves order but both do. Score net loss and missed-identification opportunity. Continue if lookahead wins after charging computation; stop when savings vanish under realistic costs. Preserve separate objectives for learning a maker, recovering one episode and learning to perform the task.

cards.specification: Compare frozen conclusion, append-only summary, raw evidence recomputation and an incremental factor/episode ledger. The ledger must compute incrementally rather than call the same raw decoder. Updates: true correction, false correction, retraction, irrelevant addition, unchanged repeat. Grid: history 4/16/64, source reliability 0.6/0.8/1. Continue if incremental recomputation matches the full posterior and improves latency/storage without correction-specificity failures. Stop after one implementation repair if numerical equivalence cannot be independently established. This extends G6 instead of relabeling shared code as two successes.

cards.specification: Hold the maker fixed across 1/2/4/8 contexts with different permitted actions or costs; select contexts randomly, for diversity or by expected target information. Compare population and personal models under identical observations. Score stable-preference and skill accuracy separately, with fresh contexts held out. Continue if preferences transfer after constraints change; stop stable-value attribution when a context-only predictor matches. This is the exact analogue of seeking several kinds of a person's work, informed by environment-design IRL.

cards.specification: Add a top-level choice that selects one complete proposed argument plan while leaving all chosen surface units unchanged. Contrast with many low-impact local edits. Use exact interventions to measure downstream dependence; compare edit-count weighting, uniform event weighting and target-specific intervention weighting. Grid: 2/4/8 descendant units and 0/1/4/16 cosmetic edits. Continue if one selection governs many content outcomes and the reader recovers it when evidence allows. Stop claiming character edits measure contribution. Export influence structure, not a single human-share scalar.

Compare single-person prior, role mixture and direct reader. Grid: two/three roles × aligned/conflicting aims. Continue where evidence supports role separation; stop individual attribution in exact topology twins. This is secondary to the single-maker core and must not delay Sounding Line.

cards.specification: For each artifact, enumerate several executable producing routes and retain the actual path separately. Compare a shortest-route reconstructor, a goal-conditioned plausible route and historical posterior. Score production success, path correspondence and future-choice prediction separately. Continue if added history improves correspondence beyond enactability. Stop any inference from successful reenactment alone to the actual maker's process. The exact counterexamples become Sounding Line semantic admission fixtures.

cards.specification: Select at most three substantively distinct promotions with their strongest rival and decisive ablation; freeze exact scores, settings, populations and exclusions before opening fresh worlds. Use 32 worlds by default, with whole-world paired uncertainty and fits nested inside worlds. If no positive candidate qualifies, confirm one diagnostic that separates information ceiling from decoder failure. Report multiplicity and all attempted promotions. Do not relabel new development as confirmation or allow a later discovery to replace a frozen candidate.

Fully replay each new implementation family and each semantic repair using its frozen source and complete bounded inputs; reuse hashes for unchanged identical implementations instead of mechanically replaying every sweep.
